title: Central West Alerts 1.9.1
changes: Added an optional Xweather lightning layer with age-coloured detections, responsive details, secure single-key configuration, shared server caching and Vaisala attribution.
Added archive search for current and expired incidents, with 7-day, 30-day, 90-day and one-year ranges.
Classified planned outage and maintenance notices as informational pages so they remain in Feed without being attached to incidents or map jobs.
Moved NSW RFS controls into a dedicated settings category with separate Incident RSS Feed and Fire Danger sections.
Improved the live map with responsive sizing, docked information panels and compact mobile popups.
Added official fire danger graphics, safety guidance, Total Fire Ban information and last-updated details.
Added richer aircraft details, aircraft-type map symbols and cleaner aircraft popups.
Improved incident grouping, unit call-sign normalisation and RFS incident correlation.
Added WaterNSW storage, river, algae and map data with refreshed card layouts.
Improved night-mode colours across dashboards, cards, buttons, media controls and release messages.
Added configurable RSS coverage, fire-danger coverage, test-message suppression and pager-incident expiry.
Added privacy protection for Australian phone numbers before pager messages are stored or published.
Updated agency branding and icons for RFS, FRNSW, VRA, SES and Marine Rescue NSW.
Improved PWA notifications, icon selection, mobile interaction and application health monitoring.
